commits.message:
Add seat_rows to lay students out in rows by last name

Raises ValueError for a non-positive seat count or an empty roster.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

after.rosterkit/seating.py:
# owner: platform
"""Seat students in fixed-size rows, ordered by last name."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student


# ---
def seat_rows(students: List[Student], seats_per_row: int) -> List[str]:
    """One line of text per row of seats, students sorted by last name."""
    if seats_per_row <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"seats per row must be positive: {seats_per_row}")
    if not students:
        raise ValueError("no students to seat")
    rows = chunk_rows(students, seats_per_row)
    return [format_row(number, seats) for number, seats in enumerate(rows, 1)]


# ---
def chunk_rows(students: List[Student], seats_per_row: int) -> List[List[Student]]:
    """Split students into rows of at most seats_per_row, sorted by last name."""
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.last_name)
    starts = range(0, len(ordered), seats_per_row)
    return [ordered[start : start + seats_per_row] for start in starts]


# ---
def format_row(number: int, seats: List[Student]) -> str:
    """Text for one row, e.g. 'Row 1: Dunmere, Piet | Halloway, Juno'."""
    names = " | ".join(student.display_name for student in seats)
    return f"Row {number}: {names}"
